description: Which classes of the pretrained (COCO-80) YOLO model count as each shared CakGo category. Only exact semantic matches are allowed; look-alike classes are NOT counted.

wallet.note: COCO has no wallet class. 'handbag' is a different object and is not used as a substitute.

keys.note: COCO has no key / keys class.

glasses.note: COCO has no eyeglasses / sunglasses class ('wine glass' and 'cup' are drinkware).
